title: 18650 cell spacer for a 4S2P pack
prompt: Cell spacer for a 4S2P battery pack made of 18650 cells: a 5 mm thick plate with eight holes in a 4 x 2 grid that the cells push through. The cells are 18.4 mm at most, so make the holes 18.6 mm, on a 21 mm pitch both ways. The plate is 88 x 46 mm with the grid centred on it. I'll print one for each end of the pack.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (print it twice for both ends)
88 x 46 mm plate, 5 mm thick, ±0.1 mm
Eight 18.6 mm cell holes (18.5–18.9) in a 4 x 2 grid on a 21 mm pitch
The grid is centred: the outer cells are 12.5 mm from both edges, the inner ones 12.5 and 33.5 mm
Exactly eight holes, nothing else cut out
Eight cylindrical hole walls and no other round faces

notes: 18650 cells: 18.0–18.4 mm diameter; 18.6 holes leave 0.1 mm per side. 21 mm pitch leaves 2.4 mm between cells; plate margin 3.2 mm.
